description.value: The Tartan Toque is a Victoria neighbourhood taphouse and wing restaurant that has won 'Victoria's Best Wings' multiple times since opening in 2012. Known for double-cooked crispy wings with dozens of house-made sauces, scratch-made burgers, and a rotating selection of local craft beers on tap, it offers casual comfort food in a relaxed setting. Dietary-friendly options including gluten-free, lactose-free, and vegetarian items are available throughout the menu.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 69m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 78m. Total: 8 spaces.
